objectives: Renew a passport or ID card at a government office
Ask about forms, documents and fees
Use 'have to' and 'must' for rules and obligations

grammar.explanation: Use 'must' and 'have to' to talk about rules and obligations at offices. 'You must sign here.' 'You have to bring your passport.' For questions, say 'Do I have to…?': 'Do I have to make an appointment?'
grammar.explanationAr: نستخدم «must» و«have to» للتعبير عن القواعد والالتزامات في المكاتب، مثل: يجب أن توقّع هنا، وعليك أن تحضر جواز سفرك. وفي السؤال نقول: هل يجب عليّ تحديد موعد؟

examples.en: Do I have to make an appointment?
You have to fill in this form.

vocabulary.example: The office is on Main Street.
Check your documents before you travel.
My passport is valid for five years.
Show your ID at the desk.
Renew your card before it expires.
Put your signature at the bottom.
I came to collect my certificate.

lt.en: I want to renew my passport.
Where do I get the application form?
lt.ar: من أين أحصل على استمارة الطلب؟

lt.en: You have to fill in this form first.
lt.ar: يجب أن تملأ هذه الاستمارة أولاً.

lt.en: Do I have to pay a fee?
Please take a number and wait.
My ID card expires next month.
lt.ar: تنتهي صلاحية بطاقة هويتي الشهر القادم.

lt.en: How long does it take to renew a passport?
You must sign at the bottom.
I need two copies of this document.
lt.ar: أحتاج إلى نسختين من هذا المستند.

lt.en: Bring your old passport with you.
The office opens at nine in the morning.
Is this the right window for passports?
lt.ar: هل هذا هو الشباك الصحيح لجوازات السفر؟

lt.en: What documents do I need?
I have an appointment at ten o'clock.
The clerk checked my papers.
Your photo is too old.
Where is the waiting room?
The queue is very long today.
Do you have a pen I can borrow?
Please write your full name here.
lt.ar: من فضلك اكتب اسمك الكامل هنا.

lt.en: How much is the renewal fee?
I lost my ID card last week.
You can apply for a new one online.
lt.ar: يمكنك التقدم بطلب جديد عبر الإنترنت.

lt.en: It takes about two weeks.
The office opens at eight in the morning.
Please keep this receipt safe.
lt.ar: من فضلك احتفظ بهذا الإيصال في مكان آمن.

lt.en: This form is only in English.
Can someone help me fill it in?
lt.ar: هل يمكن لأحد أن يساعدني في تعبئتها؟

lt.en: My application is still in process.
When will I get my new card?
You will get a call next week.
lt.alt: You'll get a call next week.

lt.en: I brought all the required documents.
Do you need a copy of my contract?
The certificate is ready for collection.
Please check the information before signing.
lt.ar: من فضلك تحقق من المعلومات قبل التوقيع.

lt.en: Is there a photocopier in the building?
lt.ar: هل توجد آلة نسخ في المبنى؟

lt.en: The office is closed on Fridays.
I don't understand this section.
Ask the clerk at window five.
Don't forget your appointment slip.
lt.alt: Do not forget your appointment slip.

lt.en: You have to wait for your number.
The staff were very helpful.

fb.display: I need to ___ my passport next month.
fb.en: I need to renew my passport next month.
fb.ar: أحتاج إلى تجديد جواز سفري الشهر القادم.

fb.display: Take a ___ and wait for your turn.
fb.en: Take a number and wait for your turn.

fb.display: Sign your name at the ___ of the page.
fb.en: Sign your name at the bottom of the page.

fb.display: I need a ___ of my certificate.
fb.en: I need a copy of my certificate.

wo.en: Where do I submit the application?
The passport office is on the second floor.
Do I have to bring photos?

mc.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: I have to bring my passport.
I has to bring my passport.

mc.question: What should you do before signing a form?
mc.ar: ماذا يجب أن تفعل قبل توقيع الاستمارة؟
